title: Public eval suites allowlist
description: Decides which raw eval suites in gs://guidance-evals are rebuilt into the public dashboard. Changed by pull request only. This schema is enforced by src/harness/public/allowlist.ts at load time; the one rule it cannot express (wildcard include patterns must start with nightly-) is checked there too.

include.description: Suite IDs or glob patterns (* and ? only) that are eligible for publishing, e.g. nightly-*-codex_cli.

exclude.description: Exact suite IDs that must not be published even if they match include.

releasedModels.description: Model identifiers (as recorded in evals.json#model) that may appear publicly. Empty means nothing publishes.

retention.description: How much history stays published. Older or surplus suites are dropped from the public copy on the next build; their raw data is untouched.

maxAgeDays.description: Drop suites whose raw evals.json is older than this many days.

maxSuites.description: Keep at most this many of the newest suites.
